title: Charge and energy practice sheet
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Seeded from gcse-science/y10 lesson 60 (Charge and energy practice sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 60: Current as a flow of charge, and potential difference. To understand current as the rate of flow of charge and potential difference as energy transferred per unit charge

model.title: A current of 3.0 A flows for 20 s through a 12 V motor. Calculate the charge and the energy transferred.

questions.q: A current of 0.5 A flows for 2 minutes. Charge? [2 marks]
questions.model: Formula: Q = I × t. Convert: 2 minutes = 120 s. Substitute: 0.5 × 120 = 60. Q = 60 C.

questions.q: 12 C pass through a lamp with 6 V across it. Energy transferred?

questions.a: 1 joule of energy per coulomb of charge.

questions.q: Core: Six Q = It and E = QV questions (portal worksheet).
questions.a: Answers in the key, e.g. 2 A for 30 s = 60 C; 60 C at 9 V = 540 J.
questions.model: Teacher does question 1: 2 A for 30 s: Q = 2 × 30 = 60 C.

questions.q: Extend: A phone battery supplies 3.7 V and passes 5000 C. Energy transferred? [2 marks]
Stretch: Explain why the current is the same before and after a lamp in series. [2 marks]
questions.a: Charge is conserved; electrons are not used up (1); the same number pass each point per second (1).

questions.q: Q = I × t. Q is measured in...
Big question: what actually moves in a wire when a lamp lights?
questions.a: Free electrons drift through the metal; they transfer energy from the supply to the lamp.
